He did not follow the rules even though he was aware of the consequence of this violation . What type of clause is the underlined one?
You can stay where you like .Here the underlined clause is a/an-
Scientists discovered the truth that the earth moves round the sun . The underlined clause is a/an -
Qualifying for the BCS exam requires hard work. the underlined part is-
My sister, who is an excellent pianist , performed a beautiful recital. Here the underlined part is a/an -
Unless you respect him , he will not respect you. The underlined part is-
It is obligatory that you submit your assignment by Friday . The underlined part is an example of -
The path through the woods is very muddy. Here, the underlined part is-
In case you feel sick , call your doctor immediately. The underlined part is -
This kind of machine is out of date . The underlined phrase is a/an -
I will go where he lives . This is a/an -
University is a place of endless opportunities . Here, underlined part is:
I know the boy _____ came from Kolkata.
e: বাক্যে খালি জায়গার পরেই verb (came) আছে এবং পূর্বপদ the boy একজন ব্যক্তি, তাই কর্তা হিসেবে who বসে। Relative pronoun দুটি বাক্যাংশকে যুক্ত করে এবং আগের noun-এর কথা ফিরিয়ে আনে। ব্যক্তির জন্য who, whom, whose; বস্তুর জন্য which বা that বসে। Whom বসে কর্ম হিসেবে, আর whose বসে মালিকানা বোঝাতে।

q: The girl, from India, has been chosen as the Vice President. Here 'from India' is a/an -
"The library is in front of my house." - Here 'in front of' is a/an -
Since it was raining , we stayed indoors. Here the underlined part is -
The writer has wanted to live in a cabin by the lake . The underlined phrase is a/an -
The woman standing at the podium is my mentor. Here, the underlined part is-
The house in the corner is for sale. The underlined part "in the corner" is-
e: In the corner শুরুতে preposition থাকা শব্দগুচ্ছ, যা house-কে বর্ণনা করে, অর্থাৎ কোন বাড়িটি তা বলে (Which house?)। কোনো noun বা pronoun-কে modify করা phrase-কে adjective phrase বলে, তাই এটি adjective phrase। Noun phrase আবার noun-এর মতো কাজ করে, যেমন subject বা object হিসেবে বসে। বাক্যটির অর্থ: কোণের বাড়িটি বিক্রির জন্য।
